description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for Git's pseudo-merge bitmap features, including setup, traversal, threshold handling, pattern matching, overlap detection, reuse, and boundary traversal.

methods.name: test_pseudo_merges
methods.description: Tests the creation and output of pseudo-merge bitmaps.

methods.name: test_pseudo_merge_commits
methods.description: Dumps pseudo-merge commits for a given index.

methods.name: test_pseudo_merges_satisfied
methods.description: Checks that the pseudo-merge objects satisfy certain conditions during traversal.

methods.name: tag_everything
methods.description: Tags all commits in the repository with refs/tags/* for testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A function used across the test script to define expected successful test steps.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
